title: Windsurf/Devin Desktop Bug Fixes
description: Bug fixes and improvements including enhanced in-IDE search functionality and new Mac icons. This update updated the bundled Devin Local agent to version 2026.5.26.

title: Remove Awkward Inner Scroll on Onboarding API-Key Card
description: Fixed a GUI layout issue where the onboarding API-key card was trapped in a cramped nested scroll area in the empty chat state. The fix ensures proper flex container behavior and natural layout flow.

title: Week 25: Artifacts Beta and Enhanced Auto Mode
description: Launched Artifacts feature in beta for Team/Enterprise plans, transforming session output into live shareable pages. Enhanced deny/ask rules now match tool parameters, /config sets settings from prompts, and auto mode blocks destructive git commands.

title: Continue v2.0.0 - Major Version Release
description: Major stable release of the Continue VS Code extension, marking a significant version upgrade from v1.x to v2.0.0. This represents a major milestone in the extension's development lifecycle.

title: Continue v2.1.0 - Pre-release Version
description: Pre-release version v2.1.0 of the VS Code extension, released as a follow-up to the major v2.0.0 release, indicating ongoing development and refinement of the v2.x series.

title: Remove GitHub Issue Reporting Entrypoints
description: Fixed GUI issue by removing GitHub issue reporting entrypoints from the application. This update includes stream error dialog formatting improvements and restoration of package metadata for VS Code.

title: Week 26 Updates: MCP Login, Shell Mode Improvements, and Rewind
description: Added shell-based MCP authentication commands (claude mcp login/logout), automatic shell mode responses to command output, /rewind command to resume conversations from before /clear, and improved background subagent permission prompts in main sessions.
